vibe_rationale: Independent and experimental publishing at the core, hosted by a respected contemporary art space; small and single-scene, which matches SURPLUS's alternative tone.
fit_notes: An art-literate adult zine and publishing crowd, a niche hobby with little health relevance, so the value is credibility rather than reach. The fair is free and institution-hosted, so any brand role would need to be light-touch and agreed with the IMA.
